notes.title: May 15 Update
notes.content:
-fixed bug after buying all available patches in a wreck while using a controller
-fixed bug after selecting a second part of a color you already own(on the first time)
-fixed error that would sometimes happen when switching between a level and the map
-fixed bug with sabre not always hitting enemies
-fixed star validation when resetting in the mod shop
-fixed an enemy sometimes not attacking when it should
-adjusted costs of patches
-adjusted harmony rewards from harmonic shape combos
-increased some icons sizes
-missile can no longer be fired if there are no enemies in range

notes.title: STAR SALVAGER LAUNCH DAY
notes.content:
Embark on an unforgettable journey as we celebrate the launch of our indie game, Star Salvager! 

Join us on our Steam page for an intergalactic adventure like no other. Our livestream features the charismatic Lil Diver at the helm, guiding us through the cosmos with courage and humor. Watch as he plunges headfirst into action, confronting the alien horde while honing his salvaging skills amidst the stars. 

But it's not just about the gameplay—it's about the sense of community, the shared laughter, and the camaraderie that make this experience truly special. Don't miss out on the excitement, join us for a thrilling ride filled with endless fun and unforgettable moments. Star Salvager awaits, and the universe is calling—will you answer?

notes.title: STAR SALVAGER ft. Mermaid Unicorn
notes.content:
Thanks for hoping on our stream! We are thrilled to have had Mermaid Unicorn join us for their very first play through of our new game, STAR SALVAGER. 

Mermaid Unicorn is a Canadian streamer, gamer and musician. We are introducing them to Star Salvager and aiding them on their journey through space. 

Will they survive the alien horde? Stay tuned to find out. 

Star Salvager is a retro / roguelike / action / puzzler, Inspired by the arcade-hall classic. 
Our indie game studio is working hard to bring you an epic sci-fi adventure in 2024! 
With your support, we can make it happen. 
Wishlist us on Steam and be the first to experience the magic of Star Salvager!

Want to stay connected? We are also launching on XBOX and SWITCH!
You can receive a 20% launch day discount on all platforms by signing up on our website:
www.agamestudios.ca/starsalvager 

Thanks for watching :)
